days.subject: Probability & Statistics
days.cover: Random experiments, sample space, events; probability axioms; complement & addition rule; mutually exclusive vs exhaustive events; equally likely outcomes; classic dice, cards, coins & urn problems
days.mustKnow: P(A∪B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A∩B) · mutually exclusive ≠ independent

items: Classical probability: P(A) = favourable outcomes / total equally likely outcomes
Axioms: 0 ≤ P(A) ≤ 1, P(S) = 1; complement P(Aᶜ) = 1 − P(A)
P(A∪B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A∩B); 3 events: add singles, subtract pairs, add triple
Mutually exclusive: P(A∩B) = 0 ⇒ P(A∪B) = P(A) + P(B)
P(at least one) = 1 − P(none)
Two dice: 36 outcomes; deck: 52 cards = 4 suits × 13 ranks

days.subject: Probability & Statistics
days.cover: Joint & marginal probability from tables; conditional probability; multiplication rule; independent events (pairwise vs mutual); total probability theorem
days.mustKnow: P(A|B) = P(A∩B)/P(B) · independent ⇔ P(A∩B) = P(A)·P(B)

items: P(A|B) = P(A∩B)/P(B), P(B) > 0
Multiplication rule: P(A∩B) = P(A)·P(B|A)
Independent ⇔ P(A∩B) = P(A)·P(B) ⇔ P(A|B) = P(A)
Total probability: P(B) = Σ P(B|Aᵢ)·P(Aᵢ) over a partition {Aᵢ}
Marginal from a joint table: P(X = x) = Σᵧ P(X = x, Y = y)
Mutual independence of A, B, C needs all pairs AND P(A∩B∩C) = P(A)P(B)P(C)
